column1: metric-definition|练习队列有6笔已观察满7天的订单，其中J退款两次、K退款一次，其余未退款。写一张指标卡，求按订单计的退款率。~Six orders complete seven-day follow-up. J is refunded twice and K once. Write the metric contract and calculate the order refund rate.|分子2笔、分母6笔，约33.33%；退款事件3次另列，不能混用。~Two refunded orders among six:33.33%; report three refund events separately.

sql-joins|订单K金额50、L金额50、M金额20；明细K有12和8，M有5，L无明细。写每单一行的查询，再说明把明细金额>10放在ON或WHERE的差别。~Orders K=50,L=50,M=20; lines K=12/8,M=5,L none. Query one row per order and compare line_amount>10 in ON versus WHERE.|先汇总得到K20、M5，左连保留L未知。订单总额120；直接连接总额170；SUM(DISTINCT订单金额)=70同样错误。~Aggregate to K20,M5 and retain unmatched L. Order total120; raw join inflates it to170; SUM(DISTINCT order_amount)=70 is also wrong.

aggregation|渠道C有30单、3退款，D有70单、14退款。输出分组和整体退款率，再只保留至少50单的组。~Channel C has30 orders/3 refunds; D70/14. Report grouped/overall rates and retain groups with at least50 orders.|C10%、D20%、总体17%；组筛选后仅D。声明总计是在组筛选前还是筛选后。~C10%,D20%,overall17%; only D survives. Declare whether totals precede or follow group filtering.

missing|应收到6条读数，实际金额为12、空、0、24、空。区分缺记录、缺值与零，计算覆盖和均值。~Six readings expected; received12,missing,0,24,missing. Distinguish missing rows/values/zero and compute coverage/mean.|有效3条、金额和36、均值12；字段覆盖3/5，记录到达5/6。~Three observed values sum36,mean12; value coverage3/5 and arrival5/6.

duplicate-conflict|原行1/2均为A=8；行3 B=9、行4 B=11，均无时间；行5 C=0。写去重与待裁决清单。~Rows1/2 A=8; rows3/4 B=9/11 without timestamps; row5 C=0. Produce deduplication and conflict logs.|A折叠一行并保留来源，B两行待查，C零保留。不能按金额大或文件顺序选B。~Collapse A with provenance, retain both B variants and genuine zero C. Amount/file order cannot resolve B.

quality-rules|40单中30单需寄送，3单缺邮编、2单邮编含非法字符。写完整性与有效性规则、分母、负责人和修复复核。~Thirty of40 orders require shipping; three lack postcodes and two are malformed. Specify rules, denominators, owner and recheck.|完整性失败3/30；有效性需声明按27个已填或30个适用记录计，不能隐藏分母。~Completeness failure3/30; declare validity denominator27 populated or30 applicable.

descriptive|响应耗时2、3、4、5、36秒。计算均值和中位数，为尾部写一句解释，并记录是否有测量错误证据。~Durations2,3,4,5,36 seconds. Compute mean/median, describe the tail and record evidence of any measurement error.|均值10、中位数4；36秒不能仅因偏高就删除。~Mean10,median4; do not remove36 solely for being high.

sampling|总体新用户20%、老用户80%；样本两组各40人，满意率90%和50%。算总体加权估计并列出覆盖假设。~Population new/returning20/80%; sample40 each with90/50% satisfaction. Weight and declare coverage assumptions.|加权58%，直接平均70%不代表总体；无覆盖人群不能凭权重补回。~Weighted58%, not unweighted70%; weighting cannot recover absent groups.

experiment|随机实验A为60/600，B为78/600。写绝对与相对变化，再列随机化单位、观察窗和继续推广前的证据。~A converts60/600,B78/600. Compute absolute/relative lift and specify unit, window and evidence before rollout.|绝对+3个百分点、相对+30%；还需要不确定性和护栏，不能只凭点估计推广。~+3 percentage points,+30% relative; require uncertainty and guardrails before rollout.

star-schema|明细X1(P1,8)、X2(P1,12)、X3(P2,15)，产品表P1=食品、P2=图书。画粒度与键，检查P1维度重复时的影响。~Facts X1(P1,8),X2(P1,12),X3(P2,15); P1=food,P2=books. Model keys/grain and diagnose duplicate P1 dimensions.|正常3行总额35；P1重复时5行总额55。保留事实键核对。~Normally3 rows,total35; duplicated P1 yields5 rows,total55. Reconcile fact keys.

pivot-tables|交易北区12、北区18、南区30，再新增南区10。设置透视字段、聚合与刷新，并独立对账。~North12/18,South30; append South10. Configure pivot fields/aggregation/refresh and reconcile independently.|按地区求和：北30、南40、总70；旧60说明范围或刷新可能未更新。~Region sums North30,South40,total70; stale60 suggests range/refresh issues.

chart-choice|季度金额Q1=20、Q2缺测、Q3=35；同季地区A=50、B=30。为趋势与分类各画草图，写缺测和基线规则。~Quarterly20,missing,35; same-quarter regions A50,B30. Sketch trend/category charts with missingness and baseline policies.|时间轴保留Q2缺口；地区条形用共享基线。金额单位及来源必须可见。~Keep Q2 missing on the time axis; use shared-baseline bars for regions and label units/source.

decision-brief|本周退款率从8%升至10%，同时退款队列口径发生变化。写观察、证据、限制、下一步四段简报。~Refund rate moves8% to10% while the cohort definition changes. Write observation,evidence,limits and next action.|先按同口径重算；不能直接断言服务变差。下一步要有负责人和核验条件。~Recompute under a common definition before blaming service; assign owner and verification condition.

task-baseline|客服工单100条中升级20条；关键词规则识别15条真实升级并误报10条。定义任务、基线与漏分风险。~Of100 tickets20 require escalation; keyword rules find15 true escalations and10 false alarms. Define task,baseline and miss risk.|召回15/20=75%，精确15/25=60%；别用总体准确率掩盖漏分。~Recall75%,precision60%; overall accuracy can hide missed escalations.

python-data|构造CSV：id为0004、0005、0006，日期为2026-02-01、bad、空。写转换脚本并保留原列。~Build CSV IDs0004/0005/0006 with dates2026-02-01,bad,missing. Convert while preserving raw columns.|ID保持字符串；第二行无效、第三行缺失；展示两个掩码而非全部填零。~Keep string IDs; row2 invalid,row3 missing. Show separate masks rather than zero-filling.

split-leakage|客户C1有1月和3月记录，C2有2月记录；目标是预测新客户未来行为。写划分与预处理拟合顺序。~C1 has January/March rows,C2 February; predict future behavior for new customers. Design splitting and fit order.|按客户隔离，再考虑时间边界；预处理只在训练集拟合，不能随机拆行泄漏同人。~Separate customers and consider time; fit preprocessing only on training data, avoiding shared-person row leakage.

generalization|模型A训练误差2、验证9，B训练5、验证6。选择后续调查，保留最终测试集。~Model A train/validation error2/9,B5/6. Plan investigation while protecting the final test set.|A泛化差距更大；可用交叉验证评估稳定性，不能把测试集变成反复调参集。~A has a larger generalization gap; evaluate stability with CV, not repeated test-set tuning.

output-contract|抽取工单编号、类别和优先级；输入一条没有优先级、另一条类别为未允许值。写JSON结构和失败行为。~Extract ticket ID,category,priority; one input lacks priority and another has an invalid category. Specify JSON/failure behavior.|显式必填/可空/枚举，先结构验证再业务判断；无法确认就保留未知或拒绝，不能编值。~Specify required/nullable/enums; validate structure then business semantics. Preserve unknown/reject rather than fabricate.

retrieval-grounding|资料仅说明“支持7天内退货”，用户问“使用30天能退吗”。设计检索证据与缺证回应。~The source only permits returns within7 days; the user asks about30 days. Plan retrieval evidence and missing-evidence handling.|引用7天规则并说明无法由资料确认例外；不能把相似问题当作30天批准。~Cite the7-day rule and disclose unknown exceptions; similarity is not approval for30 days.

tool-boundaries|助手能查订单并生成退款预览；真实退款需客服确认。写调用权限、确认点和超时后处理。~An assistant can read orders and preview refunds; actual refunds need staff confirmation. Specify permissions/confirmation/timeout behavior.|预览不能触发写入；超时先查结果与幂等键，不能无条件重复退款。~Preview must not write; after timeout reconcile result/idempotency before retrying a refund.

metric-tradeoff|阈值T1检出8真例、4误报；T2检出6真例、1误报；真实正例10。算两组指标并讨论漏检成本。~T1 detects8 true positives/4 false alarms; T2 detects6/1;10 actual positives. Compare metrics and miss cost.|T1精确2/3、召回80%；T2精确6/7、召回60%。选择依成本和人工容量。~T1 precision2/3,recall80%;T2 precision6/7,recall60%; choose by costs/capacity.

eval-cases|退款规则仅允许未发货取消。写正常取消、已发货、缺订单、恶意要求越权四类评测用例。~Cancellation only before shipment. Design normal,shipped,missing-order and authority-bypass evaluation cases.|每类有输入、可观察预期与证据；拒绝越权不等于回答能力不足。~Give input,observable expectation and evidence; refusing unauthorized actions is correct behavior.

failure-review|10个失败中6个证据缺失、3个格式错、1个工具越权。写优先级与回归集，记录风险而非只数频率。~Ten failures:6 missing evidence,3 format errors,1 unauthorized tool call. Prioritize and define regression cases.|越权虽少但可能优先阻断；修复检索不能顺带放宽写权限。~The rare authorization failure may be blocking; retrieval fixes must not widen write access.

reproducibility|两次运行得分不同，模型版本、提示模板和样本文件均未固定。写最小可复现清单。~Two runs differ while model,prompt and dataset are unpinned. Produce a reproducibility manifest.|固定输入/版本/参数/评测规则并留哈希；随机性和外部模型更新仍需说明。~Pin inputs,versions,parameters and scoring with hashes; disclose remaining randomness/provider changes.

monitoring|线上平均准确率稳定，但某类新工单大量转人工。设计分群监测、基线与告警核查。~Overall accuracy is stable while a new ticket category escalates heavily. Design sliced monitoring/baselines/triage.|看分群覆盖、拒答与人工接管，不只看总均值；先核对标签延迟。~Monitor sliced coverage,abstention and takeover rather than averages; check label delay.

human-oversight|一个建议可能影响客户账户冻结。设计需人工介入的证据包、负责人和暂停条件。~A recommendation could freeze an account. Define human review evidence,owner and stop conditions.|展示来源、置信限制和可逆行动；人必须可拒绝和改正，不应只是机械确认。~Expose sources,uncertainty and reversible actions; reviewers must be able to reject/correct.

network-path|DNS查找超时，直接访问已知IP可到达网关但应用返回502。画请求路径并区分两处症状。~DNS times out; known-IP traffic reaches a gateway which returns502. Map the path and separate symptoms.|DNS故障和上游502是不同证据；IP直连还可能改变TLS名称与路由，不能直接当等价探测。~DNS and upstream502 differ; IP access may alter TLS names/routing and is not an equivalent probe.

transport-trust|浏览器到网关HTTPS，网关到服务HTTP。画信任边界与证书校验点，说明内部链路风险。~Browser-to-gateway HTTPS,gateway-to-service HTTP. Map trust boundaries/certificate checks/internal risk.|外部TLS不自动覆盖内部一跳；核对链、主机名、有效期和内部网络约束。~External TLS does not secure the next hop; verify chain,name,validity and internal constraints.

authorized-scope|书面范围只有测试域test.example.invalid、合成账户和周五窗口，生产域被排除。列计划与停止条件。~Authorized scope includes only a test domain,synthetic accounts and Friday window,excluding production. Plan work/stops.|不跨生产与其他租户；异常数据或影响超范围时停止并联系授权人。~Do not cross production/tenant boundaries; stop and contact the authorizer on unexpected data/impact.

authentication|用户登录后修改密码，再从旧设备退出。设计会话生命周期检查，不使用真实账户。~A synthetic user changes password and logs out an old device. Design lifecycle checks without real accounts.|明确产品撤销策略；检查旧会话能否继续访问，不把前端隐藏视为失效。~Declare revocation policy and test old-session access; UI hiding is not invalidation.

authorization|A拥有订单X，B拥有Y，客服仅可查看。写读取与取消的权限矩阵。~A owns orderX,B ownsY,staff is read-only. Build read/cancel permissions.|A只能取消X，B只能取消Y，客服不能取消；服务器逐请求与对象验证。~Owners cancel only their own orders; read-only staff cannot cancel. Enforce each request/object on the server.

secrets|测试密钥K已泄露，新密钥L已生效。写轮换与验证顺序，记录K何时失效。~Test keyK leaked and replacementL is active. Plan rotation/verification and K revocation.|先验证L接入再撤K并查K被拒绝；重启服务不等于撤销K，日志不要留完整密钥。~Verify L, revoke K and confirm denial; restart is not revocation and logs must redact secrets.

event-logs|事件E1=10:00+08，E2=02:01Z，共享session=S；E3无session。统一时间并写关联限制。~E1=10:00+08,E2=02:01Z share sessionS;E3 lacks it. Normalize time and state correlation limits.|E1=02:00Z，比E2早1分钟；不能凭相同IP强行把E3归入同会话。~E1=02:00Z,one minute beforeE2; shared IP alone cannot link E3 to the session.

triage|一账号出现20次失败后成功，来源IP也被多人共享。写正常重试与异常访问两种假设和验证。~Twenty login failures precede success from a shared IP. Compare normal retry and suspicious-access hypotheses.|成功不自动证明入侵；查设备、会话、时间线和后续行为，优先保留证据。~Success alone does not prove compromise; inspect device/session/timeline/subsequent actions and preserve evidence.

incident-handoff|告警A9，02:00Z起，订单查询部分失败；日志L17显示超时，根因未知。写接班记录与下一次更新时间。~AlertA9 since02:00Z; some order reads fail,logL17 shows timeout,root cause unknown. Write handoff/update time.|分清事实、假设、影响范围、已做动作、责任人与下一步；不得把超时直接写成数据库损坏。~Separate facts,hypotheses,impact,actions,owner,next step; timeout does not establish database corruption.

threat-model|上传服务接收文件名、内容并写对象存储。画输入、处理、存储边界与三项控制验证。~An upload service accepts names/content and writes object storage. Map boundaries and three control checks.|检查对象访问授权、路径/类型限制与隔离处理；边界图不是渗透测试通过证据。~Check object authorization,path/type restrictions and processing isolation; a diagram is not penetration-test evidence.

safe-input|搜索值为O'Neil，排序字段只能date或amount。写值参数化及字段白名单的不同处理。~Search value O'Neil; sort fields only date/amount. Separate value parameterization from field allowlisting.|值使用绑定参数；排序标识符用映射白名单，不能直接把用户输入拼入SQL。~Bind values; map identifier choices through an allowlist rather than concatenating input.

verify-control|控制目标是阻止B读取A的订单，修复后正常A请求成功。补齐拒绝与回归证据。~A can still read A's order after a fix intended to block B. Add denial and regression evidence.|B读取必须拒绝且无敏感数据；再测A正常路径与客服受限路径，不能只测成功。~B must be denied without data; test A and restricted staff paths, not only successful access.

service-account|采集服务只读/var/log/app，只能写/var/lib/collector。设计服务账号与失败检查。~Collector reads only /var/log/app and writes /var/lib/collector. Design account and denial checks.|不给交互式管理员权限；用合成目录验证允许与拒绝，不对真实系统改权。~Avoid interactive admin privilege; validate permissions in synthetic directories without changing real systems.

http-diagnosis|一次请求DNS成功、TLS成功、HTTP403，另一次TCP连接超时。记录证据并定位下一步。~One request passes DNS/TLS but returns403; another times out connecting. Record evidence/next steps.|403已到HTTP层，应查身份/权限与网关规则；连接超时不能直接归为权限错误。~403 reached HTTP:inspect identity/authorization/gateway; connection timeout does not establish a permission failure.

signal-triage|12:00发布，12:02延迟升高，12:04 CPU升高且请求量翻倍。写时间线与对照假设。~Release12:00,latency rises12:02,CPU rises12:04 while traffic doubles. Build a timeline/control hypotheses.|时间相关不等于因果；比较同版本旧流量和新旧实例，核对采样与窗口。~Correlation is not causation; compare versions/traffic and verify sampling/windows.

container-build|构建需锁文件与编译依赖，运行只需产物和非root用户。设计多阶段镜像并区分配置。~Build requires lockfile/compiler; runtime needs artifacts/non-root user. Design stages/configuration.|构建工具不必留在运行镜像；密钥不可写入镜像层，运行环境另行注入。~Omit build tools from runtime; never bake secrets into layers, inject runtime configuration separately.

deployment-health|应用启动需40秒，之后暂时无法连数据库。分别设计startup、readiness、liveness。~Startup takes40 seconds,then database becomes temporarily unreachable. Design three probe roles.|startup给启动空间；readiness撤流量；liveness谨慎判断需重启的内部失活，避免级联重启。~Startup protects initialization,readiness removes traffic,liveness targets restart-worthy internal failure without cascades.

infra-state|计划显示新增1资源、替换数据库1项。写审查与停止规则，说明不直接apply的原因。~A plan adds one resource and replaces a database. Define review/stops before apply.|替换需确认数据影响、状态和恢复路径；计划变化需重审，不能把“只有两项”当低风险。~Review data/state/recovery impacts of replacement; re-review drifted plans rather than counting changes.

four-signals|支付延迟P95升高但平均值稳定，错误率1%，磁盘队列增长。设计四信号看板。~PaymentP95 rises with stable mean,1% errors and a growing disk queue. Design four-signal monitoring.|延迟、流量、错误、饱和度分开，保留尾部；错误分母与窗口一致。~Separate latency,traffic,errors,saturation and retain tails with consistent denominators/windows.

slo-budget|月内有效请求200000，目标99.9%，坏事件150。计算预算与剩余并声明排除规则。~200000 eligible requests,99.9% target,150 bad events. Compute budget/remaining with exclusions.|预算200，剩50；窗口与有效事件定义决定数值，不能擅自删坏事件。~Budget200,remaining50; event/window rules matter and bad events cannot be silently excluded.

telemetry|请求R7经过网关与订单服务，订单日志缺trace关联。列需要补的字段及采样限制。~RequestR7 crosses gateway/order service but the order log lacks trace context. Specify fields/sampling limits.|传播trace/span与请求ID，保留时间与错误；没有trace不证明请求未到达，可能未采样。~Propagate trace/span/request IDs,time,error; absent traces may reflect sampling,not absent traffic.

canary-gate|灰度100次请求失败4次，对照10000次失败100次。写同窗口比较与停止/延长条件。~Canary4/100 failures,control100/10000. Define same-window comparison and stop/extend rules.|灰度4%、对照1%；整体约1.03%会稀释信号，样本少还需不确定性与护栏。~Canary4%,control1%; pooled1.03% dilutes the signal. Consider low-volume uncertainty and guardrails.

rollback-verify|版本v3引发支付超时，回到v2后健康接口正常但旧订单状态不明。写复核清单。~v3 caused payment timeouts; after v2 rollback health is green but order state is unclear. Define verification.|验证用户交易、数据兼容和积压，健康接口成功不足以宣布业务恢复。~Check transactions,data compatibility and backlog; a healthy endpoint alone does not establish recovery.

incident-review|故障09:00开始、09:08告警、09:20止血。写时间线与两项可验收改进。~Incident starts09:00,alerts09:08,mitigated09:20. Write timeline/two verifiable improvements.|分开检测与恢复延迟；改进需负责人、期限、验证，不以追责个人代替系统分析。~Separate detection/recovery delays; assign owner/deadline/verification rather than personal blame.

semantic-html|做一个带邮箱、帮助说明、保存与取消的表单，写HTML并说明提交行为。~Build email/help/save/cancel form markup and explain submission behavior.|label绑定输入，保存type=submit，取消type=button；错误描述关联字段，服务端仍校验。~Associate label/help,save submit,cancel button and field errors; retain server validation.

responsive-css|容器宽360与1200，三张卡片中一张含80字符长词。写弹性布局并说明溢出检查。~Widths360/1200; one of three cards has an80-character word. Design flexible layout/overflow checks.|网格用minmax(0,1fr)等控制最小尺寸，内容断行按需求；不能用隐藏整页溢出掩盖问题。~Control intrinsic minima with minmax(0,1fr),wrap as appropriate and do not conceal page overflow.

dom-events|动态列表按钮含span图标。写委托删除处理，避免点击其他区域也删除。~Dynamic list buttons contain span icons. Delegate deletion without acting on unrelated clicks.|用closest定位按钮并确认属于列表，读取稳定ID；target不是总等于按钮。~Use closest plus list containment and stable IDs; target is not always the button.

keyboard|设计一个编辑对话框，含两输入、保存和关闭。列初始焦点、Tab环、Esc及返回焦点。~Design a modal with two fields/save/close. Define initial focus,Tab loop,Esc and focus return.|模态内控制焦点且关闭回到触发器；需要实际键盘核验，ARIA属性本身不完成行为。~Contain focus and restore trigger on close; verify keyboard behavior,not merely ARIA attributes.

form-errors|邮箱为空、格式错、服务器拒绝、保存成功四状态。写消息和焦点行为。~Specify messaging/focus for empty email,invalid format,server rejection and success.|具体错误靠近字段并可被读到；保留输入，成功状态可感知，不只变颜色。~Associate readable field-specific errors,preserve inputs and expose success beyond color.

async-ui|先搜apple后搜pear；pear响应先回，apple后回。写避免旧结果覆盖的方法并覆盖失败重试。~Search apple then pear;pear returns first. Prevent stale overwrite and handle failure/retry.|使用请求序号或取消并检查当前请求；404需检查response.ok，取消不是普通失败。~Use request identity/cancellation with current-request checks; inspect response.ok for404 and separate cancellation.

state-ownership|列表A/B共享一个选中项，A中删除该项。画状态归属与更新传播。~Lists A/B share selection; A deletes the selected item. Model ownership/update propagation.|选择放最近共同父级，删除同步修正选择；派生值不重复存多份造成分歧。~Own selection at the closest shared parent and reconcile on deletion; avoid duplicated derived state.

repro-build|仓库锁定依赖，package.json新增包但锁文件未改。写干净构建流程和失败预期。~A dependency is added to package.json without updating lockfile. Define clean-build steps/failure expectation.|npm ci应拒绝不匹配；修锁后复验，不能在流水线偷偷更新锁。~npm ci rejects mismatch; fix/recheck the lock rather than silently updating it in CI.

browser-tests|异步保存可能耗时1–3秒。写按名称操作与可见成功断言，并隔离每次测试数据。~Async save takes1–3 seconds. Test named controls/visible success with isolated data.|用自动等待和条件断言，避免固定sleep；服务失败也应断言错误与数据保留。~Prefer auto-waiting/condition assertions over fixed sleeps; verify error and input retention on failures.

web-vitals|实验室LCP2秒，现场移动端P75为4秒，桌面P75为2.2秒。写判断与后续采集。~LabLCP2s,field mobileP75=4s,desktopP75=2.2s. Interpret and plan collection.|实验室不代表所有真实用户；分设备与窗口调查，不能把两组P75直接求平均当总体P75。~Lab results do not represent all users; inspect segments/windows and do not average percentiles.

browser-security|用户名称含<script>片段，头像来自外域。设计文本呈现与资源策略检查。~A username contains a script fragment and the avatar is external. Design rendering/resource-policy checks.|文本用安全文本接口，避免直接HTML插入；CSP是补充控制，不能替代输出处理。~Render through text-safe interfaces rather than raw HTML; CSP supplements correct output handling.

release-checks|新注册页面改了验证规则。写正常、重复邮箱、键盘、慢网络、回滚五类上线检查。~Registration validation changes. Plan normal,duplicate-email,keyboard,slow-network and rollback checks.|每项保留版本、输入、预期、实际证据；不能只验页面可打开。~Retain version,input,expected/actual evidence; opening the page is insufficient.

http-semantics|设计读取订单和创建订单：缺登录、无对象权限、找不到、字段非法、重复请求分别返回什么。~Design read/create behavior for unauthenticated,forbidden,missing,invalid and repeated requests.|状态码与响应体依契约一致；POST本身不保证幂等，重复创建要有业务防重策略。~Keep status/body consistent with contract; POST is not inherently idempotent and needs duplicate control.

api-contract|订单查询成功含id和status，非法状态筛选需错误码。写OpenAPI片段与三种例子。~Order lookup returns id/status; invalid status filters need an error code. Write an OpenAPI fragment/three examples.|成功和错误结构分别定义；required与nullable含义不同，样例不能代替schema。~Define success/error schemas; required differs from nullable and samples are not schemas.

service-structure|订单创建需输入验证、权限、库存和持久化。给各层分配责任并设计库存不足测试。~Order creation needs validation,authorization,stock,persistence. Assign layers and test insufficient stock.|控制器处理传输，服务协调规则，存储接口处理数据；拒绝前不应残留写入。~Controller handles transport,service rules,repository data; rejected creation must not leave writes.

state-rules|待支付订单同时收到支付和取消请求。写状态转移与原子冲突处理。~A pending order receives concurrent pay/cancel. Define transitions/atomic conflict handling.|只允许一个状态迁移成功，另一请求依当前状态响应；不能先读后无条件写。~Only one transition succeeds atomically; respond to the resulting state,not unconditional read-then-write.

schema-constraints|订单号唯一、金额非负、明细必须有订单。写DDL并准备NULL、负值、重复、孤儿案例。~Orders need unique IDs,nonnegative amounts and parent-linked lines. Write DDL/null/negative/duplicate/orphan cases.|NOT NULL与CHECK分开；CHECK可能允许未知，外键需在适用环境启用并验证。~Separate NOT NULL/CHECK; unknown may satisfy CHECK and foreign-key enforcement must be verified.

atomicity|库存5，尝试创建买2的订单；写订单后扣库存失败。设计事务与重试检查。~Stock5,order buys2; stock update fails after order insert. Define transaction/retry checks.|失败后订单与库存回到一致前态；成功后库存3且仅一单，重试还需幂等控制。~Failure restores both; success leaves stock3/one order. Retries still require idempotency.

query-plan|百万订单中按唯一号取1行，另一查询取90%日期范围。写EXPLAIN审查项。~One query fetches a unique row from a million orders,another90% by date. Define plan review.|索引不一定胜过顺扫；核对估计/实际行数、循环和过滤。ANALYZE会执行语句。~Indexes are not always faster; inspect estimated/actual rows,loops,filters. ANALYZE executes the statement.

session-auth|会话S退出后再请求订单，另一个设备会话T仍在线。写产品撤销策略和预期。~SessionS logs out then requests orders while device sessionT remains online. Define revocation policy/expectations.|S必须按策略失效；是否撤销T需明确，多系统会话不能假定同步退出。~Invalidate S per policy; specify T behavior and avoid assuming cross-system logout propagation.

object-authorization|租户A和B各有同编号工单。写按租户与对象查询/更新的约束。~Tenants A/B have tickets with the same local ID. Scope reads/writes by tenant/object.|不能只按本地ID访问；授权条件应进入每次对象操作，拒绝不能泄漏对象内容。~Local ID alone is insufficient; enforce tenant/object authorization per operation without leaking denied data.

validation|分页size只允许1–100，排序仅created或amount。写size=0、101、abc及未知排序的行为。~Page size1–100; sort only created/amount. Define0,101,abc,unknown-sort behavior.|先类型/范围后映射白名单；错误不应回退为不受限全量查询。~Validate type/range then map allowed identifiers; invalid input must not trigger unrestricted queries.

integration-tests|创建订单需真实测试库，外部支付为可控替身。写成功、回滚、跨账号、重试四例。~Use a real isolated database and controlled payment double. Test success,rollback,cross-account,retry.|验证响应和持久化状态；测试后隔离清理，模拟支付不代表真实支付集成通过。~Assert responses/persisted state and isolate cleanup; a payment double does not validate a real provider.

timeouts-retry|调用已收费服务后连接断开，结果未知。写超时预算与重试前检查。~Connection drops after a charge request with unknown result. Define timeout budget/pre-retry checks.|查幂等键与结果；退避和次数上限不能解决重复收费本身。~Reconcile idempotency/result; backoff and retry caps alone do not prevent duplicate charges.

service-telemetry|同一次请求经过API与库存服务，在库存处失败。列关联ID、日志、指标和脱敏规则。~One request crosses API/inventory and fails at inventory. Define correlation,logs,metrics,redaction.|记录阶段、状态和耗时，避免密钥/个人字段；高基数ID用于日志追踪而非随意指标标签。~Record stage/status/duration without secrets; request IDs suit logs/traces,not unbounded metric labels.

dataset-grain|明细3行合计60、日汇总1行合计60。写两表粒度与不能直接联加的原因。~Three lines total60; one daily aggregate also60. Declare grains and explain why not to add both.|两表表达同一量的不同粒度，直接加会变120；比率需分子分母再汇总。~They represent the same measure at different grains; adding double-counts to120. Rebuild rates from components.

transform-sql|同日已付订单10、20，取消订单30；次日已付40。写日销售变换与对账。~Day1 paid10/20,cancelled30;day2 paid40. Transform to daily sales/reconcile.|输出日1=30、日2=40；取消金额30有单独解释，不能无痕消失。~Daily outputs30/40; separately explain excluded cancelled30.

partition-evolution|旧文件按月分区，新写入改按天。说明读一周数据时如何处理两种规格。~Old files use monthly partitions,new files daily. Explain reading a week across specs.|Iceberg按元数据理解多规格；演进不自动重写旧文件，仍需检查扫描量。~Iceberg interprets multiple specs through metadata; evolution does not rewrite old files,so inspect scans.

dag-intervals|每天02:00触发任务，要求汇总前一天。明确所用Airflow版本、timetable和逻辑窗口。~A job triggers02:00 daily to aggregate the preceding day. Declare Airflow version,timetable and logical interval.|不能仅凭cron推断区间；Airflow3触发式与数据区间式timetable不同，显式绑定起止。~Cron alone does not establish an interval; Airflow3 trigger/data-interval timetables differ. Bind boundaries explicitly.

idempotent-batch|窗口W有20行，首次写到第8行失败，再重跑相同输入。设计可重复结果与提交边界。~WindowW has20 rows; first write fails at8,then identical input retries. Design commit boundaries/repeatable output.|最终20行而非28；窗口替换需原子提交与并发控制，并核对键/金额。~Final20,not28; atomic replacement/concurrency controls and key/total reconciliation are required.

backfills|1日更正会影响1–3日滚动指标。写补数范围、顺序、资源及验收。~Correcting day1 affects rolling metrics on days1–3. Plan backfill scope/order/resources/acceptance.|先重算受影响上游再下游，记录依赖闭包；不是只补源日就结束。~Recompute affected upstream then downstream through the dependency closure,not only the source date.

event-time|5分钟窗内的事件延迟2分钟和12分钟到达，允许迟到5分钟。写处理与更正策略。~Events for a5-minute window arrive2/12 minutes late;allowed lateness5. Define handling/corrections.|明确水位假设、迟到接受和超限旁路/更正；水位不是所有事件已到的物理保证。~Declare watermark assumptions,late acceptance and beyond-limit handling; watermarks do not physically guarantee completeness.

dedup-replay|支付事件E1到达两次，E2晚两天重放；状态保留仅一天。设计键与保留策略。~PaymentE1 arrives twice,E2 replays two days late while state lives one day. Define keys/retention.|一天状态无法覆盖两天重放；保留期依风险与重放范围，事件键不能用到达时间代替。~One-day state cannot cover two-day replay; choose retention by risk/window and stable event keys.

incremental-validation|昨天100行，今天新增10、修改2、删除1。写增量期望与全量对照。~Yesterday100 rows;today adds10,updates2,deletes1. Define incremental/full comparison.|若更新不改实体数，预期109；只追加会漏修改/删除。核对受影响键和字段值。~Expected109 when updates preserve entities; append-only misses updates/deletes. Check affected keys/values.

pipeline-tests|输入重复事件ID、缺客户ID、金额-1各一条。写约束、失败去向与修复验收。~Inputs include duplicate event ID,missing customer ID,amount-1. Specify checks/failure routing/recheck.|唯一、非空、值域分别检测；拒绝/隔离与告警按契约，不能把失败行直接抹掉。~Test uniqueness,nullability,range separately; route/quarantine/alert per contract while retaining failures.

lineage|源S经任务J产出D，运行R2失败但R1成功。画Job/Run/Dataset与受影响下游。~SourceS through jobJ producesD;runR2 fails whileR1 succeeded. Map lineage/affected downstream.|任务定义与具体运行分开，记录输入版本和窗口；最近失败不等于历史产物全部无效。~Separate job/run and record input versions/window; latest failure does not invalidate all historical outputs.

freshness-recovery|仪表板要求09:00前可用，任务08:50失败，重跑预计20分钟。写通知、临时标记和恢复核验。~Dashboard due09:00;job fails08:50,retry takes20 minutes. Plan notices/stale labels/recovery checks.|及时标记数据过期，恢复需核对窗口与质量；任务绿不等于仪表板已刷新。~Mark stale data promptly; verify windows/quality/dashboard refresh rather than only a green job.

acceptance|退款必须原支付账号、未发货、金额不超剩余。写三个可观察验收条件及拒绝例子。~Refunds require original payment account,unshipped state and remaining amount cap. Define observable acceptance/denial cases.|每条条件有输入、动作、预期和证据；“退款正常”无法验收。~Each condition needs input,action,expected evidence; 'works normally' is not testable.

risk-priority|支付重复可能损失资金，帮助页错字影响低，登录故障影响全部用户。给风险排序与依据。~Duplicate payment risks money,a help typo has low impact,login failure affects all users. Prioritize with evidence.|结合影响和可能性，说明不确定性；不能只按缺陷数量或开发难度排序。~Combine impact/likelihood with uncertainty,not defect count or implementation difficulty.

test-levels|购物车价格函数、支付API、完整结算三层。分配三个风险和对应测试替身。~Cart price function,payment API,full checkout. Allocate risks and test doubles across levels.|算价可单元测，接口契约做集成，关键用户流程端到端；每层证据不可互相冒充。~Unit-test pricing,integrate contracts,end-to-end key journeys; evidence at one level does not establish another.

boundary|购买数量限定整数1–10（含）。写二值/三值边界、普通值、空值和小数的预期。~Integer purchase quantity1–10 inclusive. Define two-/three-value boundaries,ordinary,null,decimal outcomes.|二值0、1、10、11；三值加2、9；普通5通过，空与小数按整数契约拒绝。~Two-value0,1,10,11;three-value adds2,9;ordinary5 passes;null/decimal reject under this contract.

decision-tables|会员免运费；非会员金额满80也免；其他运费6。写所有条件组合与动作。~Members ship free;nonmembers with amount>=80 also free;otherwise fee6. Build combinations/actions.|会员/金额达标四组合费用0、0、0、6；明确80包含，检查每列只确定一个动作。~Four member/threshold combinations yield0,0,0,6;include80 and one unambiguous action per column.

state-transition|待支付可支付或取消；已支付可退款；已取消不能支付。列有效和非法转移测试。~Pending can pay/cancel;paid can refund;cancelled cannot pay. Define valid/invalid transition tests.|测试前态、事件、后态与副作用；重复支付不能再扣款。~Check pre-state,event,post-state,side effects; repeated payment must not charge again.

exploratory|购物车在两标签页修改数量，网络断开后恢复。写一次20分钟探索章程和观察记录。~Cart quantity changes in two tabs across disconnect/reconnect. Plan a20-minute exploratory charter/log.|保留任务、时间、数据、观察、问题与后续；探索不是随意点击且无记录。~Record mission,time,data,observations,questions,next steps rather than undocumented random clicking.

defect-reproduction|双击提交偶发两单，网络延迟300ms时更常见。写最短重现、频率和证据。~Double submit sometimes creates two orders,more often at300ms latency. Write minimal reproduction/frequency/evidence.|保留初态、准确动作、实际/预期、版本和请求ID；尚不确定根因时不要编造。~Retain initial state,actions,actual/expected,version,request IDs without inventing a root cause.

retest-regression|退款上限修复后，写原缺陷重测与余额、权限、重复提交的回归。~After a refund-cap fix,retest the defect and regress balances,permissions,retries.|重测证明原缺陷关闭，回归调查影响范围；一个成功样例不能替代两者。~Retesting addresses the original defect,regression checks impact; one happy path cannot replace both.

test-data|两条并行购物车测试使用相同账户产生串扰。设计每例数据与清理策略。~Parallel cart tests interfere through a shared account. Design isolated fixtures/cleanup.|每例独立身份与订单，固定必要时钟；清理只限拥有的测试数据，不删共享业务记录。~Use independent identities/orders and controlled clocks; clean only owned test data.

stable-assertions|保存按钮由异步请求更新为“已保存”，DOM顺序可能改变。写稳定定位与断言。~Async save produces 'Saved' while DOM order changes. Define stable locator/assertions.|按角色名称找按钮，等待可见结果与业务状态；不依赖第几个div或固定延时。~Use role/name and wait for visible/business results rather than nth-div or fixed delays.

ci-evidence|合并检查中功能断言失败一次、网络超时一次。设计日志、重试与门禁。~A merge check has one functional assertion failure and one network timeout. Design evidence/retry/gating.|分类后保留原失败，重试成功也记录不稳定性；不能无限重跑到绿。~Classify and retain original failures; passing retry still records flakiness,not unlimited reruns.

problem-model|导入工具允许空行但禁止重复编号。给输入、输出、错误契约与三个例子。~An importer allows blank rows but rejects duplicate IDs. Specify input/output/error contracts and cases.|明确空文件、全空行、重复冲突是否全量失败或部分接受；先定义再实现。~Declare empty/all-blank/duplicate handling and atomic/partial acceptance before implementation.

acceptance-slices|清单工具需创建、完成、筛选、云同步。拆最小可用切片并给每片验收。~A checklist needs create,complete,filter,sync. Slice into usable increments with acceptance.|每片交付可观察用户价值，先本地完整路径再同步；不要仅按数据库/按钮分技术层。~Each slice delivers observable value; complete a local path before sync rather than slicing by technical layer.

design-boundaries|同一业务规则需读CSV和JSON。设计解析接口与领域逻辑，说明换格式影响。~One business rule consumes CSV/JSON. Separate parsing from domain logic and explain format changes.|解析负责输入适配，领域只处理规范模型；改CSV不应复制业务规则。~Adapters normalize formats; domain logic consumes a stable model without duplicating rules.

control-flow|满100减15，金额必须非负整数。实现并列出99、100、101、-1的输出。~Discount15 at amounts>=100,with nonnegative integer inputs. Implement99/100/101/-1.|输出99、85、86；-1拒绝。验证边界与非法值，不以静默改0掩盖错误。~Outputs99,85,86;reject-1. Verify boundaries/invalids rather than silently replacing with zero.

structures-cost|1000个编号查重复，比较两两扫描和集合，说明保序及额外空间。~Compare pair scans/set detection for1000 IDs with order/space requirements.|两两最坏二次，哈希集合平均线性但需额外空间；set无序，保序另留列表。~Pair scans are quadratic; hash sets average linear with extra space. Preserve order in a separate list.

errors|导入中一行金额bad，文件本身也可能不存在。写具体异常与可恢复/停止策略。~An import row contains amount bad and the file may be missing. Define specific exceptions/recovery/stops.|解析错误与IO错误分开；保留行号和原值，不用裸except吞掉所有问题。~Separate parse/IO failures,retain row/raw value and avoid swallowing all exceptions.

unit-tests|满200减20，否则不减。写199、200、201及非法负值的单元测试。~Discount20 for totals>=200. Write199/200/201/negative-input tests.|预期199、180、181，负值依契约拒绝；断言具体结果而非仅“不抛错”。~Expect199,180,181 and contract-defined negative rejection; assert values,not merely no exception.

debugging|函数对空列表报错，普通输入正常。写最小复现、原因假设与回归测试。~A function fails on an empty list but accepts normal input. Produce minimal reproduction,hypothesis,regression.|隔离空输入触发点，先复现后单变量修改；增加空与非空对照，不能只删报错行。~Isolate the empty trigger,reproduce,change one factor and retain empty/nonempty controls.

refactor|两处折扣逻辑略有差异，其中一处边界包含等号。设计行为锁定与提取步骤。~Two discount implementations differ at inclusive boundaries. Plan behavior characterization/extraction.|先确认差异是需求还是缺陷；用测试保护契约后提取，不把行为修改伪装成重构。~Determine intentional difference versus bug,characterize behavior then extract without concealing behavior changes.

git-branches|两个本地分支修改同一配置：一改超时，一改重试。模拟冲突并记录合并意图。~Two local branches change timeout/retry in one configuration. Simulate conflict and record merge intent.|理解共同祖先和两边意图，合并后运行配置检查；删除标记不等于正确合并。~Understand base/both intents and validate the result; removing markers alone is insufficient.

code-review|修改把金额比较>=改为>且没有测试。写两条具体评审意见。~A change replaces >= with > for an amount boundary without tests. Write two actionable comments.|指出边界行为变化及补测输入；意见应说明风险与可验证建议，而非只说“不好”。~Identify changed boundary behavior and exact test inputs with risk/actionable verification.

release-version|公开API移除旧字段，同时修复不兼容行为。写版本与迁移记录。~A public API removes a field while fixing behavior incompatibly. Write version/migration notes.|依公开契约识别破坏性变化，不能因叫“修复”就随意发patch；保留迁移路径。~Judge breaking changes by the public contract,not the label 'fix',and provide migration guidance.

workflows|现状：客服收邮件后人工转单，常漏负责人。画目标流程与待确认假设。~Staff receives email then manually routes tickets,frequently missing owners. Map current/target flow and assumptions.|标触发、角色、状态、交接、异常；自动转单规则需与业务确认，不把设想当现状。~Mark triggers,roles,states,handoffs,exceptions; validate routing assumptions rather than presenting them as facts.

scope-acceptance|首期含建单和转派，不含计费；客户另提短信。写范围和变更处理。~Initial scope includes create/assign,excludes billing;customer requests SMS. Define scope/change handling.|列可验收边界与排除项，短信走影响与优先级确认，不能口头默认为首期。~Declare acceptance/exclusions and assess SMS impact/priority rather than silently accepting it.

dependency-owners|上线依赖账号、历史数据和第三方回调，只有数据未有负责人。写依赖清单。~Launch depends on accounts,historical data,callbacks;data lacks an owner. Produce a dependency register.|每项有责任人、交付时间、验收与升级路径；未分配不是“默认研发负责”。~Give owner,due date,acceptance,escalation; unassigned does not mean engineering by default.

environments|测试地址、租户、版本与邮件开关需隔离。写环境核对，防止演练发真实通知。~Isolate test endpoint,tenant,version,mail switch. Design environment checks preventing real notifications.|明确端点和非生产数据，核对开关实际生效；名称叫test不足以证明隔离。~Verify endpoints,nonproduction data and effective switches; a test name alone does not prove isolation.

role-matrix|客服可建单和看本人单，主管可分派全组，外包只读指定单。写矩阵与否定测试。~Staff creates/views own tickets,manager assigns team tickets,contractor reads assigned tickets only. Build matrix/denials.|同时限制对象范围与动作，测试跨组与写入拒绝；只隐藏按钮不算授权。~Constrain actions/object scopes and test cross-team/write denial; hidden buttons are insufficient.

migration|源150行、金额9000，试迁成功146/8750，失败4/250。写对账与失败重跑计划。~Source150 rows/9000;trial succeeds146/8750,fails4/250. Reconcile and plan retries.|行数金额对上仅解释差额，还要查键、字段、重复；保留失败清单和回退条件。~Balanced counts/totals only explain differences; inspect keys,mappings,duplicates and retain failures/rollback conditions.

uat|工单创建→转派→解决，指定客服、主管、验收人。写真实角色可执行的UAT。~Tickets create→assign→resolve,with staff,manager,acceptance owner. Write executable role-based UAT.|每步保留前置、动作、预期与业务证据，验收结论由约定角色确认，不由开发代签。~Retain preconditions,actions,expected evidence and role-owned acceptance rather than developer substitution.

cutover|切换窗口2小时，数据迁移需80分钟，回退需30分钟。排时间与不可逆点。~Cutover window120 minutes,migration80,rollback30. Schedule checkpoints/irreversible steps.|给验证与决策留时间，明确最晚回退点；不能等120分钟结束才决定回退。~Reserve validation/decision time and latest rollback checkpoint rather than deciding at minute120.

go-no-go|关键支付用例失败，界面小错字未修，回滚已演练。写上线决策。~Critical payment case fails,a minor typo remains,rollback was rehearsed. Write go/no-go reasoning.|关键失败按门禁阻断，回滚能力不抵消关键业务失败；记录条件与决策人。~Block on critical gates; rollback readiness does not cancel a critical business failure. Record owner/conditions.

role-training|新客服要学建单、补信息、升级。设计一次真实任务演练与观察表。~New staff must create,enrich,escalate tickets. Design a realistic rehearsal/observation record.|观察独立完成关键步骤与异常求助，不把签到、观看视频当胜任证明。~Observe independent actions and appropriate help-seeking; attendance/video viewing is not competence.

support-triage|用户说“登录不了”，仅知09:10开始，另一用户正常。写需要收集的信息与分流。~One user cannot log in since09:10 while another can. Collect information/triage routing.|询问错误、影响、环境、时间和可复现步骤，避免索要密码；单用户故障不代表全站停机。~Collect error,impact,environment,time,reproduction without passwords; one affected user does not establish total outage.

handoff|项目已上线但手册旧、备份责任未定、两个问题未关。写交接清单与接受条件。~Project is live but runbook is old,backup owner absent,two issues open. Define handoff/acceptance conditions.|列版本、运维、支持、风险、责任与跟进日期；上线不自动等于交接完成。~Record versions,operations,support,risks,owners,follow-up; launch is not completed handoff.
